decisions.record: Writing a limb-darkened disk without an exponent aborts CASA
decisions.inputs: cl.fromrecord for a limb-darkened disk without optionalParameters, then cl.close.
decisions.casa: writeTable stores an empty optional-parameter vector and throws casacore::indexError from the ComponentList destructor, terminating the process (CASA 6.7.6: close aborts); readTable would read out of bounds.
decisions.ours: Leaves the cell undefined, read as the shape's default exponent 0.05.
decisions.rationale: The default exponent is what every undescribed row already reads as.
decisions.impact: Such lists save and reload instead of aborting the process.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: A single spectral index is read past its end
decisions.inputs: cl.addcomponent(spectrumtype='spectral index', index=alpha) on a polarised component, then predict.
decisions.casa: The matrix sampleStokes used by every component prediction has no one-index branch and reads indices 1 to 3 out of bounds; the per-frequency version scales only I (read from source, not probed).
decisions.ours: Reads a single index as [alpha,0,0,0], so fractional polarisation is constant.
decisions.rationale: This is what the matrix sampler's comments describe.
decisions.impact: Polarised components with one index predict Q, U, V reliably instead of scaled by whatever follows the vector.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` stores four flux values as Stokes
decisions.casa: setflux stores four values with FluxRep::setValue(Vector<Double>), which resets the representation to Stokes, so the values become I,Q,U,V rather than RR,RL,LR,LL (probed with CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Does the same (owner decision 2026-10-23), including raising for an unknown name or a non-Stokes representation with one value.
decisions.rationale: Scripts get the list CASA would give them.
decisions.impact: A circular or linear four-value flux is silently read as Stokes in both implementations.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner decision, 2026-10-23 (#841), recorded in docs/CASA (C++) bugs.md.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` stores the flux in single precision
decisions.casa: setflux reads values into a Vector<Complex> (single precision), so flux=0.1 is stored as 0.10000000149011612 (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.impact: Fluxes differ from CASA's by at most 6e-8 relative.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` keeps a point for a shape it cannot make
decisions.inputs: cl.addcomponent with a misspelled shape name, a limb-darkened disk, or an axis that is not an angle.
decisions.casa: addcomponent ignores setshape's False return, so the component stays a point and addcomponent returns True (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Does the same and logs at ERROR; what setshape raises, addcomponent raises too after removing the component.
decisions.rationale: Scripts that misspell a shape get points, as in CASA.
decisions.impact: A misspelled shape yields a point source instead of an error.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA's behaviour is deliberate or users' results depend on it, casa-rs follows it.

decisions.inputs: componentlist().isphysical(), default [-1] selection on an empty list.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6-14 exits the Python process without raising an exception.
decisions.ours: Raises a catchable RuntimeError; an explicit empty index list still returns True.
decisions.rationale: A component check should not terminate its caller.
decisions.impact: Callers can recover rather than lose the Python session.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner approved a catchable error on 2026-11-05 (#1158).

decisions.inputs: A self-referential Python list passed to componentlist.iscomponentlist.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6-14 terminates the Python process with SIGSEGV.
decisions.ours: Logs the placeholder warning and returns False without recursing forever.
decisions.rationale: A type-check placeholder should not terminate its caller.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner approved correcting CASA crashes as a class on 2026-11-05; see docs/simulation/owner-decisions-20261105.md.

frequency-placeholders-casa.result: Thirty-six calls on CASA 6.7.6-14 cover all four placeholders, index types and errors; CASA logs 24 not-implemented warnings. Additional populated-list probes returned the same sentinels.

fluxpol-placeholder-casa.result: Nine CASA 6.7.6-14 calls cover the empty-string placeholder, warning, index types and errors. Empty and populated lists return the same placeholder.

indices-casa.result: Four CASA 6.7.6-14 states, including a selection, return an empty int64 array and warn. The selection case cannot yet be exercised in casa-rs.

selection-casa.result: 33 CASA 6.7.6-14 selection and conversion cases plus lifecycle checks; isolated scalar NaN, infinity and cyclic-list crashes are tracked in #1176.

fluxerror-casa.result: Twelve CASA 6.7.6-14 calls cover nonzero real and complex errors, index narrowing and argument errors; the CASA-created table is retained.

isphysical-casa.result: 18 CASA 6.7.6-14 cases cover physical and nonphysical Stokes fluxes, selections and index errors; an empty index vector returns true. The empty default selection terminates an isolated CASA process (#1158). Six additional CASA-created table rows test complex Stokes and correlation-basis fluxes.

getshape-casa.result: 44 CASA 6.7.6-14 cases cover point, Gaussian and disk shapes, supplied units, rename and reopen, argument and index handling.

record-shape-units-casa.result: Four point, Gaussian and disk shapes at each of three stages: added, renamed and reopened, including axis and angle units.

iscomponentlist-casa.result: 87 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls cover argument forms, oversized integers and empty, populated and released lists; a separate cyclic-input process exits with SIGSEGV.

setlabel-casa.result: 20 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls cover successful updates, index and argument errors, Unicode, byte strings and preservation of other components; table lifecycle and invalid UTF-8 behavior are also recorded.

removal-casa.result: 34 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls in 12 scenarios cover removal, recovery, purge, selection, component values, shape units and errors; isolated empty-list calls crash. Duplicate indices lose a different component in CASA.

sample-casa.result: 78 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls cover argument conversion and empty, populated and released lists; an isolated cyclic argument crashes CASA.

convertfluxunit-casa.result: 19 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls compare conversions, arguments and complex flux and error values in tables. Separate cases cover a redefined unit, a nonconforming source and an isolated empty-list crash.

convertfrequnit-casa.result: 19 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls compare conversions and arguments; separate cases cover table persistence, recovery, unit redefinitions, and isolated invalid-unit crashes.

setfreq-casa.result: 24 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls compare frequency changes, argument conversions and errors; separate cases cover a BARY-frame table, redefined Hz and an isolated invalid-unit crash.

setfreqframe-casa.result: 56 CASA 6.7.6-14 calls compare frame names, prefixes, indices and argument errors; a table case covers frame, frequency and error persistence. At that evidence revision, Undefined was not yet implemented.

undefined-frequency-casa.result: CASA 6.7.6-14 records Undefined frequency identity and refusal of cross-frame conversions, component tables with string, explicit, remapped and inferred integer references, invalid table-reference aliases, and MS mappings in which code 64 means LSRK and 9 means Undefined; type-only MS frequency metadata defaults to REST, while an integer reference column with no mapping arrays uses standard codes.
undefined-frequency-casa.scope: Undefined frequency measures, component-list frame updates and table reference mappings.

keyword-reads-casa.result: 32 CASA 6.7.6-14 keyword read cases cover defaults, detached tools, missing and dotted names, nested records, typed arrays, read-only tables and argument errors; a CASA-created table exercises persistence and cross-tool updates.

keyword-writes-casa.result: 25 CASA 6.7.6-14 cases cover defaults, detached tools, types and errors, nested records, read-only reopen and persisted keywords; independent tests check concurrent writers, already-open readers and integer overflow.
